batches.note: Open-air opening beat (owner directive 2026-08-04, /new-delve open-air rule). The entry hall is the only beat staged outside the keep proper, so its roof and its two valley-facing walls come off: Barrowmere's gate yard, its outer wall long collapsed. The keep walk plane and the cherry-valley gap floor are the same plane by the spec-0026 datum equation (both top y=63) and the valley moat grounds the scene footprint, so the carve opens onto continuous walkable ground: the party spawns in the open looking at the cherry rim, not down a corridor, and can walk out under the keep's own elevated corridors. The surviving +X and +Z walls keep the socket doorway and hold the keep interior enclosed; every later beat stays indoors on purpose, and the spec-0013 boundary clock owns anyone who wanders far out across the gap floor.
